name: Li-Gong
summary: Li-Gong develops industrial humanoid robots, collaborative mobile robots and factory software in Guangzhou. Its manufacturer brochure presents the Lidian humanoid family alongside machine-tending, logistics and material-handling systems. The company supplies robot hardware and digital factory tools for coordinating work across manufacturing environments.
